background_description: Ukuze ikukhusele ngexesha lokwenene 'Zero-Click' kunye ne-phishing, i-Da-Costa app idinga imvume yokuhlola izaziso zesixhobo sakho kunye nokugcinwa kwemidiya ngasemva.
background_point1_desc: Sinqanda amakhonkco e-WhatsApp anobungozi kunye nemihloko yevidiyo ekrokrelekayo ngaphambi kokuba ucofe.
background_point2_desc: Sihlalutya ithoni ye-imeyile engenayo ukumaka amaqhinga okuzenza 'CEO'.
background_point3_desc: I-Da-Costa isebenzisa i-Zero-Prompt AI. Siphatha imetadata yokhuseleko kwalapha ekhaya kwaye siyicime ngokukhawuleza. Asizange sizigcine iincoko zakho zobuqu.
background_disclaimer: Ngaphandle kwezi mvume, i-Da-Costa inokuskana iifayile kuphela ngesandla xa i-app ivuliwe.
dashboard_subheader_full: Isimo se-SOC esidibeneyo siyasebenza. I-sentry yangasemva yexesha lokwenene ihamba.
dashboard_subheader_limited: Imo yokuskana ngesandla yenziwe yasebenza. Isakhiwo sakho asikhuselekanga ngokupheleleyo.
dashboard_limited_mode_card_desc: I-Sentry yangasemva icinyiwe. Ukhuselo lwakho lusekelwe ekuskaneni ngesandla ngaphakathi kwe-app. Vula ukhuselo olupheleleyo kukhuseleko lwexesha lokwenene elizimeleyo.
dashboard_autonomous_desc: I-Da-Costa ngoku isebenza kwimo ye-'Zero-Interaction'. Inkqubo iskena zonke iimidiya eziphumayo, amakhonkco kunye nonxibelelwano kwalapha ekhaya isebenzisa i-AI inferences.
dashboard_alerts_desc: Ukutya kwexesha lokwenene okudibeneyo kumvuzo wokhuseleko ozimeleyo.
account_page_desc: Lawula ulwimi lwakho, ubhaliso, iikhredithi kunye nezicwangciso zemali.
account_language_region_desc: Khetha ulwimi lwakho oluthandayo kwi-interface ye-app.
account_explore_premium_desc_free: Vula zonke iimpawu kwaye ufumane izikena ezingenamda.
account_explore_premium_desc_premium: Jonga zonke iimpawu ze-premium kwaye ulawule ubhaliso lwakho.
payment_modal_terms_desc: Ikhutshwa ngeGoogle Play. Ivuseleleka ngokuzenzekelayo ngaphandle kokuba icinywe kwiiyure ezingama-24 ngaphambi kokuphela.
payment_modal_terms_link: Funda imigaqo epheleleyo yoBhaliso kunye nokuBhila
payment_modal_terms_checkbox: Ndiyifundile kwaye ndiyavumelana nemigaqo yoBhaliso kunye nokuBhila.
sovereignty_page_desc: Lawula i-digital footprint yakho kunye nezicwangciso ze-metadata ze-sentry yangasemva.
sovereignty_controls_desc: Lawula indlela imetadata yezokhuselo egcinwa kwaye ithunyelwe ngayo khona.
sovereignty_danger_zone_desc: Iintshukumo apha zisisigxina kwaye zihambelana neLungelo lakho lokuLibaleka.
sovereignty_erasure_desc: Cima i-akhawunti yakho, imbali yokuskana, kunye neekredithi eziseleyo ngokusisigxina.
sovereignty_delete_confirm_desc: Hleze oku kuya kucima i-akhawunti yakho, iikhredithi kunye neelogi ngokusisigxina. Eli nyathelo alinakurhoxiswa.
sovereignty_reset_app_desc: Hleze oku kuya kukuphupha kwaye kuqalise inkqubo yokukhwela kwakhona kwasekuqaleni.
sovereignty_reset_confirm_desc: Oku kuya kucima imeko yakho yokukhwela kwaye kukuphumelele. Idatha ye-akhawunti yakho ayisayi kucinywa.
sovereignty_reset_toast_desc: I-app ngoku iya kuqalisa kwakhona kwasekuqaleni.
lure_detector_page_desc: Ubunjineli bentlalontle kunye nokufumaniswa kobuqhophololo kwimidiya yakho kunye nemiyalezo.
lure_detector_logs_desc: Iziphumo zexesha lokwenene ezisuka kumhloli wobunjineli bentlalontle yangasemva.
lure_detector_zero_interaction_desc: I-Da-Costa isebenzisa ubono lwekhompyutha lwasekhaya kunye ne-NLP ukuchonga iipatheni zobuqhophololo kwi-WhatsApp statuses kunye ne-SMS ngaphandle kokulayisha umxholo wakho wobuqu.
link_scrutinizer_page_desc: Uhlalutyo lwe-URL oluzenzekelayo kunye nokhuselo lwekhonkco lepherimitha.
link_scrutinizer_logs_desc: Uhlalutyo lwavesha lokwenene lwamakhonkco afunyenwe kwizaziso zakho kunye ne-clipboard.
link_scrutinizer_autonomous_desc: I-Da-Costa ihlola onke amakhonkco e-SMS engenayo kunye namajelo okuncokola. Amalinge e-phishing aphawulwa ngokuzenzekelayo ngaphambi kokuba ucofe.
video_auditor_page_desc: Uphicotho-zincwadi lwemihloko yemidiya ezimeleyo kunye nokuthintelwa kokuxhatshazwa.
video_auditor_logs_desc: Uhlalutyo lwavesha lokwenene lweefayile zevidiyo ezintsha ezigcinwe kwisixhobo sakho (/WhatsApp/Media & /Download).
video_auditor_proactive_desc: I-Da-Costa ihlola ugcino lwakho lweefayile zemidiya ezintsha kwaye ijonga imetadata ukuchonga ukuxhatshazwa kwe-malware efihliweyo ngaphambi kokuba ifayile ivulwe.
email_analyzer_page_desc: Ukufunyanwa kokuzenza omnye umntu okuzenzekelayo kunye nokuhlala kwithala.
email_analyzer_logs_desc: Iziphumo zexesha lokwenene ezisuka kumphulaphuli we-IMAP yangasemva ye-Sentry.
email_analyzer_autonomous_desc: I-Da-Costa ngoku ihlola ibhokisi yakho yengenayo yamalinge e-BEC (Business Email Compromise) isebenzisa uhlalutyo lweelwimi ezingenastateless.
email_accounts_page_desc: Lawula iinkonzo zakho zokuhlola ezingasemva ze-IMAP/OAuth2.
email_accounts_scanning_desc: Scanning ngexesha lokwenene lokuzenza omnye umntu
email_accounts_expired_desc: Itoken ye-OAuth2 iphelelwe. Nceda ungene kwakhona.
email_accounts_why_link_desc: Ngoqhagamshelwano nge-OAuth2, i-Da-Costa isebenzisa i-IMAP IDLE ukufumanisa izisongelo ngexesha lofika kwi-inbox.
email_accounts_why_link_li1: Zero delay ekufumaneni ukuzenza omnye umntu.
email_accounts_why_link_li4: Uhlalutyo lwe-Stateless: Sihlalutya iipatheni, asiyistore isicatshulwa somyalezo.
admin_page_desc: Ingeniso yexesha lokwenene, ukusebenza kunye neengqondo zokhuseleko.
admin_fraud_console_desc: Phonononga kwaye uthathe inyathelo kumsebenzi okrokrelekayo.
policy_privacy_intro_p1: Wamkelekile kwiDa-Costa. Sizibophelele ekukhuseleni ubumfihlo bakho ngelixa sibonelela ngokhuseleko oluphezulu lwe-ciber.
policy_privacy_email_p1: I-app ye-Da-Costa ibonelela ngokhuseleko lwexesha lokwenene kwi-BEC (Business Email Compromise).
policy_privacy_email_processing_p1: I-app ihlalutya isigama kunye nethoni kwi-imeyile engenayo isebenzisa i-AI engenastateless.
policy_privacy_email_retention_p1: Asiyi kuyistore i-imeyile yakho, asiyistore kuphela imathematical representation kwi-device yakho.
policy_privacy_email_storage_p1: Umxholo we-imeyile yakho awuzange ulayishwe kwii-sevha zethu.
policy_privacy_email_control_p1: Ungakwazi ukunqumamisa uhlolo okanye ucime i-cache emva kwethuba.
policy_privacy_guarantee1_desc: Asizange siyithengise idata yakho kubantu bangaphandle.
policy_privacy_guarantee4_desc: Imiyalezo kunye nemidiya azize zigcinwe emafini.
policy_privacy_rights_p1: Phantsi kwe-GDPR, unolawulo olupheleleyo kwi-data yakho.
firstscreen_description_line1: Indlela yakho engenaphasiwedi eya kukhuseleko lwama-elite esebenzisa i-AI kuhlolo lwemetadata yexesha lokwenene.
firstscreen_description_line2: Akukho nkcukacha zokungena zigciniweyo. Nanini na.
firstscreen_stateless1_desc: Sihlalutya i-metadata kwithuba elifutshane kuphela. Iividiyo kunye nemiyalezo yakho azize zigcinwe.
perimeter_initialized_card_body: Ipherimitha iyasebenza. I-Gemini 1.5 Flash AI iqalisa ukuhlola i-digital environment yakho manje.
perimeter_invisible_protection_body: I-Da-Costa isebenza kancinci ngasemva. Uya kuva uvela kuthi kuphela xa kufunyenwe isisongelo.
perimeter_purge_body: Sicime i-metadata kwi-set-up yakho. Siyaphawula, siphinde silibale.
perimeter_stay_secure_body: Seiceáil do stádas am ar bith tríd an bpainéal.
guide_card2_body: Gach scanadh is tús nua é.
guide_card3_body: Fumana isaziso ngoko nangoko kwiimeko ezikrokrelekayo.
manual_scan_input_required_desc_lure: Tabhair téacs nó íomhá le do thoil.
login_magiclink_button: Lean ar aghaidh le Magic Link
upgrade_page_subtitle: Yiya ngaphaya kweziseko nge-Executive Sentry plan.
auth_error_invalid_state: Imeko engalunganga. Nceda uvuselele uze uzame kwakhona.
auth_error_biometric_verify: Ukubhaliswa kwe-biometric akukwazanga ukuqinisekiswa. Zama kwakhona.
auth_error_face_not_supported_desc: Ukubonwa kobuso kwesixhobo sakho akuhlangabezani nezidingo zokuphepha. Sebenzisa isigxivizo seminwe okanye i-PIN.
auth_error_biometric_not_available: Ukuqinisekiswa kwe-biometric akufumaneki kwesi sixhobo. Sebenzisa i-passkey.
premium_lock_desc: Esi sixhobo sifumaneka kuphela kubabhaliswa be-Premium. Phakamisa icebo lakho ukuze ufumane ukufikelela.
upgrade_billing_2: Ubunga buyazivuyisa ngokuzenzekelayo ngaphandle kokuba buyathintelwa ubuncinane iiyure ezingama-24 phambi kokuphela kwexesha.
upgrade_billing_3: Lawula okanye rhoxisa nangaliphi na ixesha kwi-Google Play Store Settings. Ukususa usetyenziso akurhoxisi ngokuzenzela ubunga bakho.
upgrade_billing_4: Njengesixhobo se-AI esingenabugosi, iimbuyekezo ezingapheleleyo zoxwebhu lwexabiso lwangoku azifumaneki.
upgrade_footer_1: Ukurhoxisa ngocoselelo olunye nge-Google Play Store.
firstscreen_consent: Authorized access only. Da-Costa uses FIDO2 passwordless standards and Stateless Technology — no passwords are ever created or stored.
firstscreen_magic_subtitle: Enter your details and we will send a one-time secure access link to your email.
firstscreen_magic_sent_subtitle: Check your inbox for your secure access link.
firstscreen_magic_sent_body: A secure access link has been sent to
firstscreen_magic_sent_note: The link expires in 10 minutes. Check your spam folder if needed.
firstscreen_magic_missing_desc: Please enter your User ID, Display Name and Email.
firstscreen_magic_failed_desc: Please check the email address and try again.
firstscreen_passkey_registered_desc: Your passkey was created. Now secure your perimeter.
firstscreen_missing_userid_desc: Please enter your User ID to continue.
firstscreen_biometric_register_subtitle: Use your device fingerprint or face recognition for instant passwordless access.
firstscreen_biometric_registered_desc: Your biometric was saved. Now secure your perimeter.
ad_rewarded_desc: Watch a 30-second security briefing and earn +3 free scans instantly.
ad_rewarded_success_desc: Your scans have been credited. Stay protected.
ad_rewarded_failed: Ad could not be loaded. Please try again.
ad_rewarded_premium_not_needed: You are on Premium. Unlimited scans active.
ad_zero_credits_hint: You have used all your free scans.
auth_userid_too_long_desc: User ID must be 20 characters or fewer. Please shorten it and try again.
auth_userid_invalid_desc: User ID can only contain letters, numbers, and hyphens. No spaces allowed.
auth_error_platform_required: A device biometric (fingerprint or secure face ID) is required. External security keys are not supported for this registration type.
firstscreen_biometric_face_unsupported: Face recognition is not supported for security registration on this device. Please use fingerprint or PIN.
firstscreen_fingerprint_subtitle: Use your device fingerprint sensor for instant passwordless access.
firstscreen_fingerprint_registered_desc: Your fingerprint was saved. Now secure your perimeter.
firstscreen_faceid_subtitle: Use your device secure face recognition for instant passwordless access.
firstscreen_faceid_registered_desc: Your Face ID was saved. Now secure your perimeter.
firstscreen_faceid_not_supported_desc: Your device face recognition does not meet security requirements. Please use fingerprint or PIN instead.
firstscreen_biometric_choose_desc: Select your preferred biometric authentication method.
terms_section1_body: Ngokusebenzisa usetyenziso lweDa-Costa, uyavuma ukuphethwa yile Migaqo Yenkonzo. Ukuba akuvumi, ungasebenzisi usetyenziso.
terms_billing_plans_body: Usetyenziso lweDa-Costa lunikeza i-Premium ye-'Executive Sentry'. Intlawulo iya kukhutshwa ku-Akhawunti yakho ye-Google Play xa kuqinisekiswa ukuthenga.
terms_no_refunds_body: Njengesevisi ye-AI engenabugosi, sinika inani ngokukhawuleza ekuqaleni. Ngokwenqubomgomo evamile ye-Google Play, iimbuyekezo ezingagqibelelanga azifumaneki. Ukufikelela kwakho kuzohlala kusebenza de kufike ekupheleni kwexesha elihlawuliweyo.
terms_section3_body: I-Da-Costa inika izixhobo zokuhlolwa kokuphepha kwedijithali. Uyavuma ukuba ungasebenzisi inkonzo yethu nganoma yiliphi injongo engekho emthethweni.
terms_section4_body: Usetyenziso lusebenza ngomzekelo we-freemium. Ukusetyenziswa kwamahhala kusekwa zzikhangiso nenani elincane lokuskena imihla ngemihla. Abasebenzisi bangathenga iimali-mboleko ezongezelelekileyo noba babhalise kwiplan ye-premium.
terms_section5_body: I-Da-Costa sisixhobo sokuhlolwa kokuphepha, haisi isiqinisekiso sokuphepha. Asizimisele ngalo na lumonakalo noma ukulahlekelwa okudalwa ukusetshenziswa kwakho kwekhompyutha.
deletion_request_desc: Oku kuzokhipha ngokuqinileyo i-akhawunti yakho, umlando wokubhalisa, ne-metadata yezokuphepha.
deletion_local_note: Qaphela: Izimpawu zeZwi Le-imeyili zigcinwe ngokwasendlini kudivayisi lakho. Ukuzisula, sebenzisa umsebenzi we-'Sula i-Cache' kwizicwangciso ze-app.
deletion_stateless_body: Ngenxa yokuba I-Da-Costa isebenzisa ukucutshungulwa kwe-AI okuse-stateless, asinayo i-database esembindini yezimiyalezo zakho ezihlolwe, ama-URL, noma amafayela okuwasusa. Ezi zinto zihlanzwa ngokuzenzekelayo ngaphakathi kwamasekhondi angama-30 emva kokucutshungulwa.
deletion_initiated_desc: I-akhawunti yakho icwangciselwe ukususwa. Uza kuphuma ngoku.
sovereignty_export_toast_desc: Ingxelo yakho yobukumkani bedijithali (GP-2026) ikhutshelwe phantsi.
sovereignty_cache_toast_desc: Izimpawu zezwi zasekhaya zikhishwe kudivayisi lakho.
splash_tagline_secondary:
Inkosi. Ikhethelo. Icacile.
Yakhiwe e-Afrika. Ikhankanywa Emhlabeni.
scan_card_desc_lure: Izibatha zefixa kunye nezicupho zokwakhiwa kweentlalo
sms_shield_message_placeholder: Paste the suspicious SMS or call script here...
sms_shield_tip: Tip: For best results, provide both the phone number and the message you received.
dashboard_sentry_sms_note: SMS monitoring captures notification previews. For full SMS analysis use SMS & Call Shield.
dashboard_posture_desc: Calculated from scan activity, threat history & sentry status
account_free_badge_desc: I-Da-Costa Svalinn ikhululekile ngokupheleleyo. Zonke iimodyuli zokuskena, zonke iilwimi, ukufikelela okungenamkhawulo. Akukho bhaliso lufunekayo. Akukho khredithi efunekayo. Inikwe amandla nguNvidia Nemotron kunye neAzure F0.
linked_accounts_description: UDa-Costa Svalinn uya kubeka esweni ngokuzenzekelayo iiakhawunti zakho ze-imeyile ezixhunyiwe kwi-phishing, uhlaselo lwe-BEC, kunye neenzame zokuzenza i-CEO - ukufumanisa izoyikiso ngaphambi kokuba uzivule.
linked_accounts_providers: Ababoneleli abaxhaswayo: Gmail · Umbono · I-imeyile yenkampani
linked_accounts_b2b_text: Kwimibutho efuna ukubeka esweni i-imeyile yemvelaphi yamaqela abo, nxibelelana nathi ngqo:
linked_accounts_individual: Abasebenzisi ngabanye: ukuskena i-imeyile ngesandla kuyafumaneka ngoku nge-Email Analyzer kwideshibhodi yakho.
